scope: Local CLI permission and isolated real MCP verification; not a new real-model E2E run

policy.configuration_overlay: MIMOCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT preserves provider, MCP and unrelated agent configuration; replaces only the dedicated agent safety fields
policy.global_permission_overlay: MIMOCODE_PERMISSION replaces inherited broad permissions with the default-deny policy
policy.invalid_config_behavior: Invalid JSON or non-object config/agent values fail closed before launching the CLI

debug_agent.limitation: This debug command reports the native registry, not the deferred MCP invocation catalog

mcp_stdio_discovery.isolation: Temporary config directory and database; no production credentials or endpoints

native_bash_rejection.result: Tool not found for the dedicated read-only agent

static_installed_cli_evidence.source: Embedded JavaScript in the installed MiMo CLI 0.1.12 executable; inspected locally without reading credential configuration
static_installed_cli_evidence.native_registry_filter: Agent toolAllowlist filters native tools, except the reserved invalid and mcp_tool_search entries
static_installed_cli_evidence.mcp_catalog_filter: MCP tools enter the deferred search catalog only after exact agent.toolAllowlist membership and runtime-permission checks
static_installed_cli_evidence.mcp_search_boundary: mcp_tool_search only searches that filtered catalog; returned matched names must also belong to that catalog before loading
static_installed_cli_evidence.mcp_execution_boundary: MCP calls must be loaded for the request and pass a permission check before invoking the server
static_installed_cli_evidence.conclusion: The discovery helper cannot add bash/write/edit or non-allowlisted MCP write tools through its normal loading path
static_installed_cli_evidence.evidence_type: Static inspection, distinct from actual debug execution or model calls

additional_coverage: paths with spaces and unrelated cwd

limitations: No new model call was made after adding the native-tool policy; historical real E2E evidence must be assessed separately
The seven MCP tools were discovered from a real isolated MCP server; their inclusion in the MiMo deferred catalog is supported by static CLI filtering evidence, not a new model-driven tool call
